row: We are Vale Veterinary Centre Ltd and we are based in South Wales, UK. We have branches in Barry, Cardiff and Newport. We love our job and care for the pets that we look after. We are independent and proud to do what we do. Join us on our daily journey. Please like and subscribe. Thank you.
